note: Hand input: how Ultracite came to sort keys, from `git log -S` on "sort-keys" and "useSortedKeys" in this repository, packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md, and `gh issue view` (read-only) on the issues the commits resolve. One rater. Read 2026-10-19.

events.summary: Ultracite v5 (#162) turned Biome's useSortedKeys assist off ("Disable useSortedKeys and useUniqueElementIds" in the commit message).
V7 (#466) built ESLint core from @eslint/js configs.all, which includes sort-keys, and overrode it to "off" (with sort-imports and sort-vars).

"Resolves #660" rewrote Oxlint core as an explicit list of every rule, with "sort-keys": "error". Issue #660 ("Conflict on test title descriptions") is about a different rule; no issue or PR discusses sort-keys.
"Align ESLint with Oxlint" removed the "off" override, so ESLint core gets sort-keys from configs.all with its default options.

"Align ESLint and Biome presets to the oxlint benchmark" turned useSortedKeys on, with the comment "Enforce ordering of a JS object properties. Matches sort-keys in the oxlint/ESLint configs." Changelog: "the `useSortedKeys` assist is on (matching ... `sort-keys` in the other presets)".
"Fix useSortedPackageJson action not being executed" (#757, for issue #728) turned useSortedKeys off for package.json and .github JSON, so useSortedPackageJson's conventional order applies there.

"Exempt TanStack route files from key sorting", for issue #762: Biome's useSortedKeys reordered createFileRoute options alphabetically, so head and component came before loader and loaderData was inferred as never (TS2339). The TanStack presets turned the rule off for route files.

"Disable key sorting across the TanStack presets", resolving #801: Oxlint's sort-keys fix moved onError above onMutate in TanStack Query mutation options, the onMutate context became {} and `ultracite fix` turned type-correct code into TS2339 errors. Mutation options live anywhere, so the presets turn the rule off for all files.
"Fix ESLint TanStack, Qwik, Jest, Cypress and Storybook blocks" turned sort-keys off in ESLint's TanStack preset too, matching the Oxlint and Biome TanStack presets.

Ultracite lints itself with its core preset, so its CLI source has sort-keys on; the root config turns it off for packages/cli/src/oxlint.ts and packages/cli/config/oxlint/**/*.mjs, whose rule maps are grouped by plugin and alphabetised by hand (AGENTS.md: "The sort-keys lint rule is off for preset files, so keep that order by hand").

upstream.summary: meta.docs.frozen: true, recommended: false, no fixer and no suggestions; default options asc, caseSensitive true, natural false, minKeys 2, allowLineSeparatedGroups false, ignoreComputedKeys false.
